On the road again…🚘

It's day 16 of the Schumer Shutdown. The Left continues to grandstand while @HouseGOP continues to work. My team & I are headed to visit struggling rural hospitals in MO-04 today.

Reminder that all of our offices are OPEN. Schumer is holding America hostage but WE are still working for YOU!

📍 Blue Springs, MO 

Even though Schumer shut down our government—we made it a point to visit struggling rural hospitals in MO-04 to see what we in Congress can do to support.
Thank you to CEO Robert Marsh, who joined Centerpoint in June 2022, for leading our tour and for his team’s commitment to serving patients and families with compassion.

⏳I’m not playing games — Americans are feeling this Schumer Shutdown now. From rural hospitals to military families to small businesses, the pain is real.

See why I’m drawing a line in the sand ⬇️ 
https://t.co/PYFJsReHwm

Unfortunately, Schumer still has the government in a shutdown, but we're still working for you!

Visited Landmark Hospital of Columbia with CEO Sharon Noe to learn more about the exceptional care they provide to patients needing long-term, complex medical treatment. https://t.co/n8KJdpzxIo
Their 24/7 team of nurses, respiratory therapists, and specialists work tirelessly to help patients recover and regain independence. So thankful for their service to our community.
Watch to hear what Al and his team are seeing on the front lines and what we’re doing to help protect rural hospitals and strengthen mental health care in Missouri. 👇 https://t.co/FxLi0JGUqZ

💸 Day 22 of the #SchumerShutdown, and Democrats are pushing another false narrative,  saying Obamacare premiums will “double.”

The WSJ just exposed how they’re using a misleading study to scare the public. Folks, fear doesn’t fix problems— leadership does.

🔗 https://t.co/BoHiY0NpMd

Day 22 of the Schumer Shutdown: Out on the backroads of Missouri’s 4th District, visiting with farmers and rural hospitals.

The Left could learn a lot from Missouri’s heartland. Take a listen👇🇺🇸 https://t.co/GJGGeg1KmZ

Another day of the unnecessary #SchumerShutdown, but another day we get to support rural hospitals. 

Visited Lafayette Regional Hospital in Lexington, MO, with CEO Darrell Box. 

We talked about their day-to-day operations and saw their CAT scan machine in action. Always great to be in Lexington and see the dedication of our rural healthcare workers! 💪🏽🏥

Obamacare broke our healthcare system — and Americans are paying the price. Premiums are up, choices are down, and subsidies are going straight to insurance companies.


It’s time to fix this through REGULAR ORDER and return power to the people — not Washington. 👇 https://t.co/KyaP0HxuX1

Democrats broke healthcare with Obamacare — and Americans are paying the price.

Now, under Speaker Johnson and Leader Scalise’s leadership, @HouseGOP is ready to fix it and put patients back in charge. ⬇️ https://t.co/ca4u6RM60H

Productive meeting with Golden Valley Memorial Healthcare CEO Craig Thompson. 

We talked Medicare, their HRSA grant for developing our own physicians, Missouri residency retention, RHTP funds, and closing the loophole hurting Sole Community Hospitals. 

Proud to support the providers who keep our rural communities healthy!

When the government shut down, we didn’t. We kept visiting hospitals because rural Missouri can’t afford political games. Democrats wanted to put the $50B Rural Health Transformation Program on the chopping block.

We actively fought to stop that and keep our rural hospitals open—for the families who depend on them!

Democrats set this healthcare crisis in motion. Now rural hospitals are hurting and families can’t afford care. We’ve got 24 days to act — and @HouseGOP are the only ones putting real solutions on the table. ⤵️ https://t.co/MV5KqpUSP3

Stopped by Mercy Lebanon to visit with their leadership team about how we can support our rural hospitals at the federal level. 

Jenn Speer shared an incredible program helping patients battling substance abuse leave with a 3-day supply of needed medication — with Dr. Michael Crease personally following up to ensure continued care. This is real compassion in action. 

Grateful for Jenn, LeeAnn Pendergraft, Jason Purcell, and Board Chair Greg Bechtel for the tour.

Just had an inspiring conversation with Ambassador Justice Esme J. Chombo from Malawi!

We dove into the incredible lifesaving work of Project C.U.R.E., delivering vital medical supplies and equipment straight to hospitals in Malawi, thanks to generous donors and partners. Proud to share that Project C.U.R.E. has a major hub right here in Kansas City.

The Show-Me State is making a huge global impact!

Obamacare works great…for Big Insurance.

@HouseGOP is delivering:
✅ Lower premiums
✅ More choice
✅ Real transparency https://t.co/9qfsHWwjEQ

In 2025, I proudly backed legislation that delivers REAL relief for working families:

💰 Lower taxes
🏥 Lower premiums
🧾 Less regulation
🚀 More opportunity

It’s time for a government that works for the people—and that’s exactly what @HouseGOP is delivering!!!

Proud to see @CMSgov announce Missouri will receive more than $216 million from the Rural Health Transformation Program, which Republicans created earlier this year in the Working Families Tax Cuts.

We'll never stop fighting for our rural hospitals!
https://t.co/588fw8ZkxV
